checks.accuracy: Every substantive RAG claim agrees with the reference facts. No claim that RAG guarantees correctness or normally retrains weights.
checks.coverage: Defines RAG, explains why it helps, document preparation, retrieval, context, generation, and at least two failure modes.
checks.language: Uses simple English suited to an Indian class-12 learner with limited English; no unexplained specialist terms or unnecessary complex sentences.
checks.example: Includes one internally consistent worked example with question, retrieved evidence, answer and source label, plus missing-evidence behaviour.
checks.jargon: Explains RAG and every specialist term used, including embeddings, chunks and vector stores when present.
checks.flow: Builds from a familiar problem to definition, why, how, worked example, limits and recap; no contradictory teaching steps.
checks.practice: Includes a learner exercise and correct answer plus a short knowledge check with answers.
